basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Mangalagiri Research Scientist B Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

salary_details.details: No other allowance/ facilities other than consolidated salary shall be extended.

selection_process: The selection process comprises a written test (conducted if the number of candidates applied is more) and an interview on the same day.
how_to_apply: Download the official notification and CV template (Annexure-I) from the official resources.
Fill out the CV candidate form duly typed in Times New Roman Font.
Paste a passport-size photo on the application form.
Mail your updated CV (ANEXURE-I) on or before 18 October 2026, 5:00 PM to [email protected].
Attend the walk-in document verification and interview on 26 October 2026 at 9:00 AM at the Admin Block, AIIMS Mangalagiri.
Report for registration by 08:00 AM on the walk-in date; candidates reporting after the notified closing time for registration will not be permitted.
Carry the hard copy of the application form and all Original Documents on the day of the exam/interview.
important_instructions: The posts are purely contractual for a period of five years with renewal of tenure done every 11 months from the date of joining. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Field visits will be required by the selected candidates and no additional remuneration will be paid for the same. The selected candidate shall have to do Sunday, Holiday and exigency duties as per the requirement of the laboratory. If performance of the appointee is not found satisfactory by the investigator, appointment can be terminated at any time without any notice. The appointee may be relieved from the current job position with one-month prior notice, failing which may lead to paying one-month salary. Candidates must come prepared to stay one more day after the scheduled date in case the schedule overruns, at their own cost for stay. Submission of wrong or false information during the process of selection shall disqualify the candidature at any stage. Any form of canvassing will lead to disqualification of candidature.
